notes.subject: ארץ ארץ ארץ
notes.rationale: Threefold repetition of 'žeme' — solemn summons to the land itself, rhetorically lost if reduced.

notes.subject: klausyk
notes.rationale: The verse is an imperative summons — the earth itself is called to hear.

notes.subject: žeme
notes.rationale: Direct address to the land as addressee.

notes.subject: kurį sako Jahvė
notes.rationale: Hebrew construct 'word of YHWH' rendered with relative clause Lithuanian requires.

translation: Žeme, žeme, žeme, klausyk žodžio, kurį sako Jahvė!
